meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在查看代码时会改用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个结构探索工具，替代直接整文件读取：先搜索定位文件和符号，再看文件结构骨架，最后按需展开单个函数或类的完整源码。
howto.when: 当你要查看代码结构、查找函数或高效探索代码库时触发，处理时会优先用结构搜索而不是 Read/Grep/Glob。

say.text: 搜索一下 src 目录里所有跟 shutdown 相关的函数
say.note: 会触发结构搜索，返回匹配符号和文件概览。

say.text: 看下 worker-service.ts 的文件结构
say.note: 会返回这个文件的所有函数和类的大纲。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude explores code via smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold instead of reading whole files: it first finds files and symbols, then shows a structural skeleton, then unfolds the full source of a chosen function or class.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to inspect code structure, find functions, or efficiently explore a codebase; it prefers structural search over Read, Grep, and Glob.

say_en.text: Search for all shutdown-related functions in the src directory
say_en.note: Triggers structural search; returns matching symbols and file overviews.

say_en.text: Show the file structure of worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Returns an outline of all functions and classes in that file.

say_en.text: Unfold the shutdown method in services/worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Shows the full source of that method.
